newsitem.title: USA: Utah 875 MW coal-fired unit shut for planned work.
newsitem.headline: Utah 875 MW coal-fired unit shut for planned work.

text.p: The 875 megawatt (MW) Intermountain Power coal-fired unit at Delta, Utah, was shut as expected Friday night for planned maintenance, sources familiar with the plant's operations confirmed Monday.
The unit is expected to be down until May 6.
The plant's other 875 MW unit was said to be operating normally.
Intermountain Power is a consortium of mostly municipal utilities, including the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power.
